Senior Software Engineer, AI Model serving - Taipei, Taiwan

Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

What We Offer

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Sênior Data Engineer:

Estamos buscando pessoas engenheiras de dados com background e expertise na área, criativas, com energia, comprometidas, que saiba trabalhar bem em equipe, com foco de resolver o problema do cliente com muita qualidade e que queiram encarar conosco o desafio de fazer parte do time de tecnologia responsável pelo Crédito da Stone.

Nosso produto está na rua a todo vapor e queremos escalar ainda mais nosso produto ampliando a sua capacidade, aproveitando todo seu potencial e melhorar ainda mais os pilares técnicos e de eficiência. Nosso produto tem interação com diversas fontes de dados importantes e cruciais para a vida do ciclo de crédito, sejam nossos dados internos cadastrais e transacionais, dados de provedores externos sobre endividamento, restritivo, rede de relacionamento, garantias e os diversos dados internos da companhia. Integrar, transformar e disponibilizar esses dados não é uma tarefa fácil e com todo volume que temos o desafio se torna ainda maior. Pra continuar no caminho certo, precisamos das melhores pessoas, que saibam contribuir bem em time e trabalhar sem ego, afinal, só como um time temos grandes resultados!

Importante lembrar que o nosso desafio requer pessoas com pensamentos de processar dados, construindo processos de qualidade e dispostas a construir sistemas altamente escaláveis e resilientes.

Junto ao time, você será responsável por:

  • Você irá compor um time de alta performance com o foco em: projetar, desenvolver, testar, implantar, manter e melhorar o processos de engenharia de dados com foco em solucionar problemas reais dos nossos clientes;
  • Auxiliar na construção de soluções com visão de longo prazo e muita qualidade;
  • Você será um defensor das boas práticas, nossos acordos e processos, revisões, testes e documentações dentro do seu time e influenciar esta cultura o máximo possível;
  • É esperado de você extrema facilidade de trabalho em equipe, muita franqueza e transparência para que no dia-a-dia possa ter ótimo relacionamento com o time e transmitir conhecimento;
  • Aqui todos possuem a mente aberta para trabalhar com qualquer tecnologia, muita vontade de aprender e entregar resultado, além de ser apaixonado por tecnologia e sistemas de alta performance;

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em linguagem de desenvolvimento para ferramentas e rotinas de Data Engineering (Python, Java, Scala ou outras);
  • Processo de Data Quality / qualidade e testes para Engenharia de Dados;
  • Conhecimentos de processamento com Databricks / ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Experiência com operação de serviços na nuvem;

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Conhecimentos de negócio de Crédito e Risco;
  • Conhecimento de provedores de dados como SCR, Boa Vista (BVS), Serasa etc;
  • Experiência em projetos voltados para a área financeira;
  • Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias em geral é sempre um diferencial;

???? Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Auxílio Creche

Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

title: [C] Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
description:
Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
Location: Latam (Remote)

About the Role

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Specialist to plan, build, and optimize campaigns that drive user engagement, monetization, and retention. You'll own the execution of push notifications, in-app messages, and email marketing using tools like MoEngage and Purchasely, while working closely with Product and Engineering to deliver highly personalized lifecycle journeys.

Success in this role over the first 3-6 months will mean:

  • Launching and maintaining multiple lifecycle campaigns with accurate targeting and triggers
  • Improving key engagement and retention metrics through A/B testing and segmentation
  • Delivering consistent campaign performance reports with actionable insights
  • Building strong cross-functional partnerships to execute promotions and paywall strategies

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute lifecycle marketing initiatives for user engagement and monetization
  • Build, test, and deploy campaigns across push, in-app, and email channels
  • Maintain MoEngage campaigns, including testing, deployment, and tracking results
  • Work with Engineering to set up attributes and triggered events for campaigns
  • Support user journey mapping and personalization by profile
  • Contribute to monetization strategies, promotions, and win-back campaigns
  • Optimize performance via segmentation, surveys, and A/B testing
  • Produce weekly and monthly performance reports with recommendations
  • Coordinate campaign assets, briefs, copy, templates, and segmentation lists
  • Stay current with new marketing technologies and capabilities

Requirements

  • Based in Latin America with C1C2 English fluency
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
  • 1+ year in Lifecycle or Growth Marketing
  • Hands-on experience with mobile CRM platforms (MoEngage, CleverTap, or Braze)
  • Strong copywriting, organizational, and project management skills
  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering on lifecycle triggers
  • Ability to interpret customer data for targeted campaigns
  • Detail-oriented, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Purchasely or similar monetization tools
  • Familiarity with paywall strategies and in-app monetization tactics
  • Strong analytical skills for campaign optimization

Compensation & Logistics

  • Full-time
  • Aligned with U.S. Eastern Time working hours

Company Overview

Visual Blasters is a creative technology company building engaging digital experiences. We value innovation, collaboration, and a user-first mindset. You'll be joining a team passionate about delivering fun, impactful products to millions of users worldwide.

title: YouTube Editor
description:
Overview

YouTube Editor

When you apply, please ensure the subject line is: I actually read the instructions

If you can\'t edit like this, this job is not for you. You must at least be able to edit at this level:

This is another example. If you can edit like this, you are very likely to get higher pay:

A Impact Media is on a mission to make great real estate agents known well.

At A Impact Media, we don\'t just create videoswe transform real estate businesses. If you\'re exceptional at what you do and align with our core values: proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence, we want to know you.

We\'re hiring a YouTube Editor to join our specialized creative team serving 55+ real estate clients on a full-time, remote basis.

Role:

As a YouTube Editor focused on real estate content, you will play a critical role in transforming raw footage into high-impact content. These retention-driven videos generate millions in sales for our clients. You will work directly under our YouTube Manager and alongside a high-performing media team, shaping stories that drive growth and strengthen personal brands. This role combines creative ownership with collaborative problem-solving, turning real estate expertise into world-class content together.

Responsibilities:

As a YouTube Editor focused on real estate content, your role is to transform direct-to-camera, area-touring videos, and agent expertise into high-impact, retention-driven videos that generate leads and build authority. You\'ll solve the problem of turning valuable real estate insights into world-class content that holds attention and drives growth.

  • Edit and deliver multiple high-quality YouTube videos every week, maintaining consistent 72-hour turnaround times
  • Communicate daily, promptly, and often
  • Collaborate with team members to create engaging promotional content from long-form edits
  • Report progress daily and align priorities to maintain seamless workflows
  • Conduct competitor analysis and trend research to stay ahead of industry standards
  • Keep project files and asset management well-organized and up-to-date
  • Share editing resources (e.g., motion graphics templates, intros) with other team members
  • Identify potential challenges early and communicate solutions effectively
  • Provide feedback on raw footage to the production team for improved outcomes
  • Contribute to data collection, video retention graphs, and conduct post-mortem reviews for continuous improvement
  • Offer constructive revision feedback to other team members on their edits
  • Monitor client channels for performance metrics and optimization opportunities

Requirements:

We\'re looking for someone who combines technical mastery with a growth mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, high-standard team environment. You should love solving creative problems and care deeply about delivering content that truly impacts viewers.

  • Minimum 2-3 years of professional editing experience
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects; familiarity with other tools (DaVinci Resolve) is a plus
  • Solid foundation in motion graphics, or a willingness to quickly learn and integrate on-brand graphics
  • A portfolio showcasing your best work (required)
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with a proactive and solutions-focused mindset
  • Ability to balance speed and quality and align with brand standards and overall creative direction
  • Eagerness to experiment with new tools, workflows, and approaches to stay ahead
  • Strong alignment with A Impact Media\'s core values and team culture

You\'ll be expected to contribute not just as an editor but also as a creative partner, helping to build a culture of excellence across the media team.

Results:

Your work will directly support our clients\' channel growth and elevate content quality, ensuring they stay ahead of industry standards and audience expectations.

  • Deliver high-quality edits on time, driving strong retention and watch time metrics
  • Support a consistent publishing cadence by maintaining a healthy backlog of ready-to-go content
  • Contribute to growing our clients\' reach and impact, targeting strong view velocity and engagement metrics
  • Maintain creative standards across the team by contributing to internal systems, workflows, and overall visual direction in alignment with client brands
  • Enable real estate professionals to deliver consistent, high-value market insights to their audiences content that would not exist without your contribution

Location:

Fully remote position - work from anywhere with reliable WiFi

Compensation:

1,400 - 2,200 per month based on volume output, skill & experience; 30-60 day paid trial period to ensure mutual fit

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work environment
  • Work with 55+ established real estate clients generating $10M+ income annually
  • Part of a dedicated team of 55+ creative professionals
  • Structured production system with clear processes and support
  • Growth opportunities into creative management/leadership roles
  • Flexible workload options

A Impact Media Core Values

Our core values determine who succeeds here. The right person will live these values, not just read them.

Beyond Excellence

We raise the bar, then we raise it again. Good enough is not good enough. We find joy in the pursuit of mastery and believe excellence is a moving target.

Extreme Ownership

Own the outcome. Take full responsibility for results. Say "I will" instead of "they should." Measure yourself by your clients\' success.

Proactive Curiosity

Curious minds build better things. Question everything. Connect ideas others miss. Ask "What if?" and "Why not?" See challenges as opportunities to learn.

Mission Focused

Small things build big things. Align personal purpose with professional pursuit. Find fulfillment in the work itself. Believe that helping others succeed is the highest calling.

To apply:

If you\'re interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Editor.pdf)
  • Details of your video editing experience
  • Send a link to your completed personality quiz (Google CVI if link doesn\'t work):
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible" - Khalil Gibran

Submissions should go to:

I will be looking for people who can format their submission in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in client management you want to help make it as easy on the client as possible! I\'m happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

title: YouTube Manager
description:
A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media.

At A Impact Media, we hire for impact. If you’re exceptional at what you do and align with our core values—Beyond Excellence, Extreme Ownership, Proactive Curiosity, and Mission Focused—we want to know you.

Role

We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media. The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who translates our clients’ business priorities into long‑form video content, and builds the top real estate channels across the country.

You’re not just managing YouTube channels. You’re leading strategy, storytelling, and systems behind uploads that scale our clients’ local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube. You are a multifaceted creative fluent in ideation, production planning, copywriting, post‑production oversight, and YouTube analytics. You’ll work to craft standout content that changes how top agents and teams approach media and market dominance. You will lead production, posting, and packaging direction, distill insights into engaging content, and ensure continuous improvement through analysis and feedback loops. You’ll maintain strategic alignment with key business initiatives and collaborate with YouTube Strategists, Client Success Managers, the creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

If the idea of leading and growing YouTube’s top real estate channels excites you, let’s talk.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure
  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre‑production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre‑ and post‑production workflows; prototype AI‑driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion
  • YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture
  • Support channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and experimental formats
  • Ensure every video educates and reinforces the authors’ authority, credibility, and mission while maintaining each brand’s distinct tone
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run A/B tests on back catalogue
  • Keep scorecard metrics up to date and share weekly insights with team and clients
  • Pre‑Production
  • Support ideation and research sessions
  • Provide feedback on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four‑to‑six‑week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts, title options)
  • Post‑Production
  • Own post‑production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve engagement
  • Collaborate with Senior Editor for retention notes and final approvals
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post‑production
  • Results
  • Support 45‑60+ videos monthly within your team, managing around 5–10 clients
  • 90%+ on‑time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100–1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and $7.5–$10M+ in sales per client per year)
  • 50–75% of videos outperform baselines on impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber‑to‑view ratios; higher average views and faster velocity
  • Regular documentation of content experiments and A/B tests
  • Improved use of AI and other tools to increase team leverage
  • Positive client sentiment on brand and growth

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape—concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development; bonus points for a large educational channel
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., Frame.io)
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Notion)
  • Proficiency with G Suite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop is a plus but not required

Communication Expectations

  • We use Slack as the primary communications tool
  • We value over‑communication and speed in responses
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings
  • Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader
  • Weekly meetings with the creative team

Location : Remote (work from home)

Hours : Mon – Fri 9am–6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed

Compensation : $16,800 – $28,800 USD annually with progression from part‑time to full‑time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000–$36,000 USD per year.

Benefits

  • 30–60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part‑time to full‑time path)
  • Remote work flexibility

description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Tech Lead, you will play a strategic role, serving as a technical reference and team leader. This position requires a balance between technical expertise, people leadership, and project management.

  • Define team objectives and project goals, ensuring alignment with the company's broader strategies and objectives.
  • Facilitate communication within the squad and across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment and timely delivery of high-quality outcomes.
  • Actively participating in the recruitment, training, and development of team members, fostering a productive and growth-oriented environment.
  • Collaborating with other technical leaders, aligning technology strategies and contributing to the evolution of the company's technical direction.
  • Ensuring the technical quality of deliverables, providing guidance and support in solving complex problems.
  • Promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices within your squad and chapter, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.
  • Guide conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration in your team.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure technical initiatives, such as refactoring, performance tuning, and tech debt—are properly scoped and prioritized within the product backlog.
  • Ensure implementation of quality and observability standards, including automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and logging across the development lifecycle.
  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts, driving team evolution through feedback and actionable insights.
  • Support team staffing decisions by matching people to tasks based on skills, priorities, and development opportunities.
  • Support the definition and follow-up of individual development goals aligned with team objectives and business priorities.
  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Proven track record of leading teams and working in product-driven companies.
  • Hands-on experience in backend (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS) and optionally frontend development, with a track record of delivering scalable systems.
  • Experience in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Experience working with domains of medium to high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web and mobile applications work including security, session management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and experience designing or maintaining microservices-based systems.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web and mobile technologies and techniques.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.
  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and experience with agile methodologies.
  • Advanced Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Skills.
  • Ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Competence in defining clear objectives and ensuring the team meets project milestones.
  • Experience guiding and leading teams to successful project deliveries within deadlines and budgets.
  • Ability to evaluate and prioritize technical work based on business value, system health, and long-term platform goals.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Active contribution to aligning technological strategies with broader organizational objectives.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, facilitating alignment and decision-making.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with Product Managers, Product Owners, Squad Leaders, Designers, and other teams, tribes or squads in defining priorities and delivering value.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, guiding career development, and fostering a growth-oriented, high-performance team environment.
  • Capacity to make thoughtful, context-aware decisions that balance technical debt, delivery speed, and business impact.
  • Ability to recognize team dynamics, support team members through challenges, and cultivate psychological safety.
  • Proactive in owning outcomes, addressing blockers, and ensuring that the squad delivers on commitments.
  • Comfortable working in changing environments, reprioritizing as needed, and adjusting to new business or technical demands.
  • Skilled in managing disagreements constructively and promoting consensus through dialogue.
  • Capable of influencing product and technical decisions at squad level and beyond, aligning technical initiatives with broader company goals.
  • Oriented toward retrospectives, feedback loops, and implementing process and culture improvements.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability, with a bias for action and results-oriented problem solving.
  • Comfort operating at both strategic and hands-on levels, flexing between system design and stakeholder engagement as needed.
  • Ability to make decisions based on accurate information, technical indicators, and impact metrics, using data to prioritize initiatives, guide trade-offs, and measure success.


Industry-Specific Knowledge

As a Tech Leader, you bring practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand the operational workflows, regulatory considerations, and business impact that shape these areas.

You leverage this knowledge not only to guide the technical implementation of backend solutions, such as payment orchestration, fraud-detection services, or onboarding flows, but also to collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and business stakeholders in defining priorities and making trade-offs that balance technical feasibility with strategic objectives.

Your role involves translating domain-specific requirements into actionable tasks, mentoring engineers to understand the business context behind their work, and ensuring the team delivers solutions that are robust, compliant, and aligned with customer needs. You help the squad connect technical work with revenue, performance, and user experience outcomes, creating an environment where engineers contribute with full awareness of business impact.

Process Stages

HR Interview
Our first contact will be a casual conversation to learn about you, your career journey, and align expectations. We’ll conduct a brief technical assessment and answer your questions about the role, our culture, and what makes us unique. We want you to get to know us better too! ????

Now it’s time to showcase your technical talent! In this step, you’ll solve technical cases and have a discussion with our engineering team. We’ll dive into your decisions, strategies, and how you design scalable and robust solutions. Beyond evaluation, we want to exchange ideas and explore how your solutions can impact RecargaPay!

Conversation with Leadership
Here, you’ll meet the squad leader to understand the position’s challenges, discuss the team’s daily activities, and evaluate alignment between our goals, culture, and your career aspirations.   • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay
At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data
By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. description:
Overview

A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media. We hire for impact and value core principles: beyond excellence, extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and mission focus. If you’re exceptional at what you do and align with these values, we want to hear from you.

Role: We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media. The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who connects our clients\' business priorities with long-form video strategy. You\'re building top real estate channels across the country, making clients locally famous, and setting a high bar for content. You\'ll own the strategy, the story, and the systems behind uploads that scale our clients\' local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube. This role blends creativity with analytics across ideation, production planning, post-production oversight, and YouTube performance.

Your curiosity for real estate fundamentals matches your passion for dominating YouTube\'s local market. You\'re excited to craft standout content that changes how top agents and teams approach media and market leadership. You\'ll lead production, posting, and packaging directions, distill insights into engaging content, and drive continuous improvement through analysis and feedback while maintaining alignment with business initiatives. You\'ll collaborate with our YouTube Strategists/Client Success Manager, creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

Location: Remote (work from home). Hours: Mon – Fri 9am – 6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed. Compensation and benefits reflect experience and progression from part-time to full-time roles.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure

  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre-production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre- and post-production workflows; identify opportunities to prototype AI-driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, Shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion

YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture

  • Support YouTube channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and other experimental formats
  • Ensure every video educates while reinforcing the authority, credibility, and mission of our clients; maintain each brand\'s distinct tone and consistency
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run consistent A/B testing for packaging on back catalogue
  • Keep relevant YouTube scorecard metrics and present weekly insights to team and clients

Pre-Production

  • Support ideation and outlier research sessions
  • Provide feedback and insight on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four-to-six-week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts and title options)

Post-Production

  • Ownership and management of post-production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve audience engagement
  • Work with Senior Editor to provide retention notes and final approval for uploads
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post-production

Results

  • Support 45-60+ videos monthly within your team; you\'ll primarily manage around 5-10 clients
  • 90%+ on-time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving subscriber growth monthly
  • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and 7.5–10M+ in annual sales per client)
  • 50–75% of videos outperform channel baselines in impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber-to-view ratios; higher average views per video and faster velocity in 24/48 hours
  • Document content experiments and A/B tests; increase AI/tool usage to boost team leverage
  • Improved client sentiment on brand and growth through performance discussions

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape — concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development (bonus for large educational channels)
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., frame.io)
  • Proficiency with Notion and GSuite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop is a plus but not required

Communication Expectations

  • Slack is the go-to for communications
  • Value over-communication and speed in responses
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings, Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader, and Weekly meetings with the creative team

Compensation

Salary range is $16,800 – $28,800 USD annually, with progression from part-time to full-time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000 – $36,000 USD a year.

Benefits

  • 30–60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part-time to full-time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance-based advancement opportunities

How to Apply

To apply, please submit: a PDF resume named according to your name, links to YouTube channels and growth metrics, a completed personality quiz URL, and responses to the following questions:

  1. What\'s the most innovative YouTube strategy you\'ve implemented and what were the results?
  2. What does the quote "Work is love made visible" by Khalil Gibran mean to you personally?

Data Scientist (AI Agent Security and Observability)

About the Role

As a Data Scientist, you will join the AI Models team at Weni by VTEX , a business unit of VTEX. You will be responsible for researching, developing, and improving machine learning models that power our conversational agents and multi-agent systems. You are driven by curiosity and impact, transforming complex data into tangible improvements in user experience and product performance.

What you will do

  • Develop tests related to the safety and ethics of generative models.
  • Research, design, and implement machine learning models to improve the performance of conversational agents and multi-agent systems.
  • Analyze large datasets to extract insights that guide model improvements and product decisions.
  • Work closely with engineers and product managers to bring AI models from prototype to production.
  • Continuously evaluate model performance and iterate based on real-world usage and feedback.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover hidden structures, anomalies, and relationships in data, informing hypothesis generation and experimental design for conversational AI systems.

Who you are

  • Familiarity with guardrail concepts in generative models
  • Familiarity with safety/ethics concepts in generative models
  • Strong foundation in Statistics
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Experience using Git for code version control
  • Hands-on practice with scikit-learn, pandas, and other data-related frameworks
  • Knowledge of Deep Learning
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS) for storage, pipelines, and deployment
  • Monitoring of performance, data drift, and data quality in production
  • Critical thinking, curiosity, and proactive problem-solving
  • Clear communication (oral, written, and visual) and collaborative work style
  • Familiarity with GenAI/LLMs (prompt engineering, fine-tuning, hallucination evaluation)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high-tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information, visit

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

About Weni by VTEX

Weni by VTEX is a business unit of VTEX dedicated to enterprise customer experience solutions powered by artificial intelligence, designed for brands and retailers.

With the Weni Platform, we redefine sales and post-sales journeys through hyperautomation and the smart integration of data into conversational channels, delivering faster, more personalized, and more efficient experiences for consumers.

  • Flexible meal allowance;

  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end machine learning models, from data acquisition and feature engineering to production monitoring.

  • Lead by example , championing a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and continuous learning within the data science team.
  • Mentor and coach junior data scientists and analysts, fostering their growth through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What we are looking for:

A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills , with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Curiosity: You are passionate about finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You seek to understand the entire value chain and how your ML models integrate with front-end applications, back-end systems, and the underlying data infrastructure to deliver business value.

  • Cloud Data Platforms: Hands-on with at least one of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Azure, Databricks

  • MLOPS: Experience with at least one: Databricks, mlflow, AWS SageMaker, Vertex AI; Git code versioning workflow and platforms (GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, etc.)

title: Senior Product Manager | Vaga exclusiva para PCD | Always Hiring
description:
Sobre o Jusbrasil

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia, cujo propósito é proporcionar e viabilizar uma Justiça melhor e gerar mais confiança nas relações sociais através do acesso à informação. Estamos caminhando para sermos reconhecidos como single source of truth para informações jurídicas e construir esse caminho não é trivial. Lidamos diariamente com problemas complexos que exigem pensamento crítico e analítico para propor soluções que nunca foram pensadas. Hoje estamos na casa das centenas de colaboradores espalhados em mais de 40 cidades no Brasil e fora. E a nossa sustentabilidade como empresa vai ser diretamente proporcional ao aumento da nossa densidade e diversidade de talentos com o crescimento desse time incrível que já temos.

Jusbrasil em números:

  • + de 1,2 bi de documentos jurídicos de interesse público
  • + de 1PB de dados na nossa infraestrutura de tecnologia
  • + de 30 m de usuários
  • + de 700 colaboradores
  • + de 80% dos advogados brasileiros cadastrados

Sobre a função

Como Product Manager no Jus, você será responsável por definições táticas e estratégicas das frentes de trabalho e produtos para alavancar os resultados da empresa. Enxergamos a pessoa PM no Jus como alguém mão-na-massa, cuja função é orquestrar e direcionar as equipes rumo à visão da empresa, além de delinear a visão dos produtos nos quais trabalha. Para fazer isso, precisará definir a priorização do produto, justificando suas posições e apostas com base em análises e pesquisas quantitativas e qualitativas. Além disso, a pessoa Product Manager é quem conecta e equilibra os resultados do negócio ao usuário, responsável por dar visibilidade do estado da empresa aos stakeholders internos e externos, via métricas, KPIs e OKRs.

Trabalhando em conjunto com times que utilizam tecnologia de ponta em Machine Learning, Information Retrieval e NPL, você trabalhará lado-a-lado de engenheiros, designers, analistas de dados, outros PMs e stakeholders em toda a empresa.

  • Conforto para desempenhar e facilitar análises de dados;
  • Capacidade de delinear a visão de negócio e ajudar nossa equipe de desenvolvedores a transformá-la em código;
  • Proficiência em gestão de equipes de produto multidisciplinares;
  • Comunicação verbal e não-verbal precisa para fazer interlocução com múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Experiência comprovada como Product Manager ou função semelhante;
  • Experiência comprovada com produtos de interface com o usuário.

Será um diferencial se

  • Já ter exercido funções como pessoa desenvolvedora, analista de dados ou marketing digital;
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de múltiplas dependências e/ou stakeholders.

Informações Importantes

“Esta é uma vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs). Acreditamos que times diversos são mais fortes, criativos e representativos da sociedade. Por isso, buscamos intencionalmente atrair e incluir profissionais com deficiência em nosso time, promovendo um ambiente acessível, respeitoso e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.

Caso você participe de um processo seletivo afirmativo para Pessoa com Deficiência no Jusbrasil, nossa equipe de Talent Acquisition solicitará a apresentação do seu laudo médico ou do Certificado de Reabilitação Profissional emitido pelo INSS. O documento deve estar assinado e validado por profissional com CRM, e será analisado conforme os critérios estabelecidos nos artigos 89 e 90 da Instrução Normativa MTP nº 2, de 08/11/2021.

Ao fornecer essas informações, você declara que elas são verdadeiras e compreende que, em casos de incompatibilidade entre o laudo apresentado e os requisitos legais da vaga afirmativa, isso poderá ser considerado no processo de avaliação e eventual não preenchimento da posição.

Esta é uma vaga para o nosso banco de talentos, que está sempre aberto para conhecer novas pessoas. Por ser uma vaga de cadastro, não temos previsão para retorno imediato, mas manteremos seu perfil em nosso radar para futuras oportunidades.

title: SDR II (Escolas)
description:
O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

No isaac acreditamos em uma venda personalizada e consultiva. Gostamos de nos conectar com o cliente de forma responsável, empática e transparente, criando relações reais e duradouras. Enxergamos a venda como o primeiro passo para transformar a gestão escolar em algo simples e eficiente.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para integrar nosso time de SDR e ajudar a abrir portas para o isaac no mercado de educação (escolas privadas). Procuramos alguém orientado a resultados, colaborativo e comunicativo, que se sinta confortável em interagir com diferentes perfis de pessoas em múltiplos canais.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Agendar reuniões com personas definidas, seguindo SLAs pré-estabelecidos;
  • Manter atualizadas as atividades de prospecção no CRM;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar cadências de prospecção, analisando métricas e buscando melhorias de conversão;
  • Qualificar e enriquecer listas de leads, garantindo informações relevantes;
  • Garantir contato rápido com clientes potenciais;
  • Atuar sempre com orientação a resultados e metas;
  • Demonstrar resiliência e adaptabilidade frente a mudanças de objetivos e estratégias;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas internas, compartilhando aprendizados e insights sobre os clientes.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Experiência em prospecção outbound e inbound;
  • Conhecimento em modelos de vendas consultivas (SPIN, BANT, GPCT ou similares);
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para textos claros e concisos;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;
  • Perfil orientado a resultados, proativo e com vontade de aprender.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas B2B;
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash Benefícios - R$40,50/dia);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui no isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vemproisaac

Declaração de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados

title: Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist Curitiba, Brazil
description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re seeking a Results-Driven & Experienced Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist to join our team.

The Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist at Common Thread Collective (CTC) plays a critical role in driving client success. You will lead the development of accurate strategic forecasts that guide our clients toward their goals, ensuring seamless execution of strategies that translate forecasts into measurable growth. Your actions and decisions consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Beyond strategic planning, you are an active partner in client growth, maintaining transparent communication about the actions taken and performance relative to forecasts. This engagement strengthens relationships and ensures that CTC’s clients have a clear roadmap to success while guiding them through the complexities of media acquisition and strategy.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's unique approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As a Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist, you set a high standard. People know that when you are involved, execution at the highest level is guaranteed.

You see your goals as barriers to break through and take great pride in giving your all. We value the mantra of “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me” meaning that you can see things through to the end!

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

KICK OFF PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the kick off.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of training, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

  • Work in an Agile Environment: Operate effectively within our agile development framework, contributing to continuous improvement and quick iterations.
  • Present and Gather Feedback: Engage with stakeholders to present completed data products and gather valuable feedback for further iterations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a Data Engineering role, with a proven track record of building and managing production data systems.

    • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, dbt, and Airflow.

  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Agile Experience: Experience working in an agile development environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with Ruby.
  • Experience in the nonprofit or fundraising technology sector.
  • Experience with SaaS.

Details

Benefits & Perks

  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes

description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re seeking a Results-Driven & Experienced Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist to join our team.

The Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist at Common Thread Collective (CTC) plays a critical role in driving client success. You will lead the development of accurate strategic forecasts that guide our clients toward their goals, ensuring seamless execution of strategies that translate forecasts into measurable growth. Your actions and decisions consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Beyond strategic planning, you are an active partner in client growth, maintaining transparent communication about the actions taken and performance relative to forecasts. This engagement strengthens relationships and ensures that CTC’s clients have a clear roadmap to success while guiding them through the complexities of media acquisition and strategy.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's unique approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As a Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist, you set a high standard. People know that when you are involved, execution at the highest level is guaranteed.

You see your goals as barriers to break through and take great pride in giving your all. We value the mantra of “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me” meaning that you can see things through to the end!

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

KICK OFF PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the kick off.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of training, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to the next level.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

Sobre a função

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Suporte que atue diretamente com clientes Enterprise/B2B em um ambiente técnico altamente complexo. Essa pessoa será responsável por auxiliar os clientes com integrações às nossas APIs, lidar com incidentes críticos e garantir um atendimento técnico de alta qualidade para clientes estratégicos. Você será um ponto de referência tanto para o cliente quanto para o time interno, atuando como facilitador entre as áreas de suporte e produto.

Suporte técnico especializado:

  • Fornecer suporte técnico de nível avançado para clientes enterprise, lidando com integrações complexas e oferecendo soluções personalizadas para suas demandas;
  • Manter um relacionamento próximo com os clientes estratégicos, antecipando suas necessidades e garantindo uma excelente experiência de suporte;

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country\'s biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You\'ll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team\'s contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right.   • High trust, low ego culture focused on outcomes over hours
  • Continuous learning encouraged through an annual learning stipend and peer mentorship
