title: Gerente de infraestrutura de tecnologia da informação
description:
Sobre Nós

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa que é referência em TI, impulsionando a inovação e transformando o mercado desde 2001?

Venha para a Qualificar TI!

Na Qualificar TI, somos especialistas em Governança de Dados, Gerenciamento de Projetos, Transformação Digital e Outsourcing. Oferecemos soluções estratégicas e as melhores práticas para atender às necessidades técnicas de nossos clientes.

O Que Buscamos

Procuramos gente apaixonada por tecnologia, que quer crescer e se desenvolver num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Queremos pessoas que:

  • Tenham perfil de Transformação Digital e sejam inovadoras.
  • Busquem continuamente por conhecimento e aprimoramento.
  • Sejam proativas e comprometidas com a entrega de resultados.
  • Valorizem o compartilhamento de experiências e o trabalho em equipe.

Por Que Trabalhar na Qualificar TI?

  • Ambiente Inovador: Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time dedicado e dinâmico, que valoriza o seu conhecimento e incentiva o seu crescimento.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo : Oferecemos um espaço onde a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento são contínuos, proporcionando a você as ferramentas e o suporte necessários para crescer profissionalmente.
  • Impacto Real: Contribua para projetos que realmente fazem a diferença para nossos clientes, utilizando as melhores práticas e soluções tecnológicas.

Se identificou? Então, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a oportunidade

Responsável por coordenar a operação da infraestrutura de TIC, envolvendo servidores, redes, bancos de dados e segurança. A atuação exige visão estratégica, capacidade de liderança técnica e foco em alta disponibilidade e continuidade dos serviços.

Atividades principais

  • Supervisionar as equipes técnicas de infraestrutura (N3 e NOC);
  • Planejar e monitorar a operação contínua dos serviços de TIC;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs, segurança da informação e estabilidade da operação;
  • Apoiar técnicos à equipe na solução de incidentes críticos;
  • Elaborar relatórios de operação e apoiar processos de auditoria.

Requisitos obrigatórios

O profissional deverá possuir curso superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) , ou curso superior completo em qualquer área , desde que complementado com pós-graduação na área de TI , realizada em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

São exigidas as seguintes certificações e formações complementares:

  • Certificação ISO/IEC 27001 ;
  • Certificação ITIL 4 , sendo exigido, no mínimo, o módulo Specialist – Create, Deliver & Support , ou certificação equivalente ou superior da mesma trilha;
  • Certificação HDI – SCTL (Support Center Team Lead) ;
  • Curso de capacitação em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux .

Além da formação e certificações, o profissional deve comprovar:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 (cinco) anos em atividades técnicas relacionadas à área de TI;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 (três) anos em gestão de projetos e liderança de equipes técnicas .

Adicionalmente, é obrigatória a apresentação de ao menos uma das seguintes certificações reconhecidas na área de gerenciamento de projetos e/ou serviços de TI :

  • PMP – Project Management Professional ;
  • CAPM – Certified Associate in Project Management

description:
Overview

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, com 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico. Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos à procura de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) altamente habilidoso(a) e apaixonado(a) por tecnologia para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Como desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack , você desempenhará um papel fundamental na criação e manutenção de sistemas robustos, escaláveis e eficientes que apoiem nossos processos de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e integração de dados. Você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, incluindo Java e React.js, NoSQL (MongoDB), arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas de observabilidade para garantir que nosso sistema seja altamente observável e fácil de depurar.

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs back end e front end que suportem os processos de ETL e integração de dados (Java e React.js);
  • Implementar soluções de armazenamento de dados NoSQL, como MongoDB, para armazenar e consultar dados de forma eficaz;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de integração baseados em eventos para facilitar a comunicação entre os diferentes componentes do sistema;
  • Trabalhar com protocolos FTP e lidar com arquivos posicionais para a troca de dados com parceiros externos;
  • Garantir que o sistema de ETL seja altamente observável, permitindo a fácil depuração de problemas e a monitoração de desempenho;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos e garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas atendam às necessidades de negócios;
  • Realizar testes de unidade, integração e aceitação para garantir a qualidade do código;
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada e participar na revisão de código;
  • Ficar atualizado com as melhores práticas e tendências em desenvolvimento back end e front end.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento back-end e front end, em um ambiente de microserviços com Linguagem Java, Spring Boot, React.js;
  • Conhecimento sólido em NoSQL, com experiência prática em MongoDB;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas ETL;
  • Experiência com Cloud (AWS, AZURE);
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos FTP e manipulação de arquivos posicionais;
  • Habilidade de escrever código limpo, escalável e de fácil manutenção;
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada;
  • Inglês avançado (atuará em time internacional).

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros. title: Wine Supervisor Club Med Resort Brazil ou no estrangeiro
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Wine Supervisor Club Med Resort Brazil ou no estrangeiro role at Club Med

Do you know Club Med? We have nearly 70 resorts, open in summer and winter, in 26 countries. We offer high-end vacations in the mountains and by the sea. Our customers are looking for happiness and freedom.

Why are you reading this job offer? Because you want to become an actor of this little extra that makes all our difference. You have human and professional skills that are in demand.

We offer you the opportunity to develop and evolve very quickly by joining our brilliant teams. You will be able to travel around the world.

Your working environment

Each Resort has several restaurants and bars, both event-based and more intimate, serving our Premium All Inclusive offer. From buffets to plated service, from show cooking experiences to numerous festive events, you will have no shortage of opportunities to express your know-how and creativity while enriching yourself with all our facets. Our refined offer is based on 5 pillars: creating memorable experiences, surprising with a multitude of conceptual catering spaces, working for the well-being of everyone (including your own), playing on the emotions and senses through the staging, all in a fun and relaxed atmosphere.

You are

  • Sociable, you know how to connect with our guests and build a trusting relationship.
  • Efficient, you know how to manage priorities and ensure timely service.
  • Attentive, you ensure each guest receives personalised service.

You will

  • Ensure the sale and service of wines and spirits in the Concept area (wine cellar and delicatessen), bars and various restaurants of the resort
  • Coach, train and motivate its team of salespeople specialized in wines and spirits
  • Listen to and advise customers carefully, according to their tastes and respecting the food and wine pairing.
  • Ensure the personalization of the customer journey and the respect of the proposed offer
  • Ensure the stock management and the good conservation of the products in the cellar and the grocery store
  • Develop additional sales and get involved in optimizing the economic results of its service
  • Organize and promote events around the products of the cellar and grocery store in the resort
  • Guarantee the application and respect of the hygiene and safety standards, as well as respect for heritage.

Joining our teams is also a unique opportunity to live and work with people from all walks of life, in the most Instagrammable locations in the world.

You'll create a golden experience on your resume, within a company that accompanies you and trains you continuously to help you become the best version of yourself.

By becoming a G.O Wine Cellar Supervisor, you will be able to benefit from the infrastructures and activities offered by Club Med. If you feel like it, you can even go on stage to show your talents!

So, ready to join us? Your future starts here… All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Seu papel será crucial para traduzir dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis sobre performance e vendas.



Main responsibilities

  • Coleta e Implementação: Estruturar e implementar planos de mensuração em plataformas de Web Analytics e Marketing, garantindo a coleta de dados de alta qualidade através de ferramentas como Google Tag Manager e Adobe Launch.
  • Modelagem e Estruturação de Dados: Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados, trabalhando com a modelagem em ambientes de Data Warehouse, especialmente no Google BigQuery, afinidade com SQL para garantir que os dados estejam organizados e prontos para análise.
  • Visualização e Análise: Criar e sustentar dashboards e relatórios interativos em ferramentas como Looker Studio e Power BI, transformando dados brutos em visualizações claras e objetivas.
  • Geração de Insights e Estratégia: Analisar profundamente os dados para identificar tendências, padrões de comportamento do usuário e oportunidades de otimização de negócio, como RFV e análises preditivas de próxima compra, churn, fornecendo insights estratégicos para os clientes.
  • Comunicação e Apresentação de Resultados: Atuar como ponto focal em questões de dados, apresentando análises, resultados e recomendações para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio, tanto em português quanto em inglês.

Requirements and skills

  • Inglês avançado para comunicação e apresentação a clientes internacionais.
  • Sólida experiência com ferramentas de Web Analytics (Google Analytics 4 e Adobe Analytics ).
  • Proficiência em gerenciadores de tags (Google Tag Manager , Adobe Launch/Data Collection ).
  • Conhecimento com ETL e utilização de APIs para coletar informações de várias fontes, limpá-las, organizá-las de acordo com regras de negócio.
  • Conhecimento em Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) , como Adobe Real-Time CDP , Treasure Data, Salesforce, Banco de Dados e Estatística.
  • Experiência prática com Data Warehouses, especialmente Google BigQuery e SQL .
  • Domínio de ferramentas de visualização de dados como Tableau , Looker Studio e Power BI .
  • Conhecimento em linguagens para manipulação de dados como Python e JavaScript .
  • Mentalidade analítica, proativa e uma grande disposição para compartilhar conhecimento e aprender continuamente.

Additional information

Diferenciais que nos impressionam

  • Experiência prévia em E-commerce ou Marketing Digital , com vivência de trabalho em áreas como Martech, CRM, CRO, Mídia e SEO .
  • Vivência com projetos de implementação de soluções de Data Analytics do início ao fim.
  • Conhecimento, vivência e experiência com implementações Adobe Experience Cloud (Principalmente, Analytics, AEP, CJA, RT-CDP e Adobe Target)

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset with flexibility to adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • High level of integrity and confidentiality.

  • We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of AI and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Awesome colleagues (top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and startup experience).

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal .

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and support our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: You will execute a customer-centric approach across all client interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (e.g., Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - LATAM

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We enable businesses to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. Our team works asynchronously, around the world, with fully remote positions. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to help us build a best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on global employment with speed, expertise, and precision. The Lifecycle team focuses on elevating HR practices through technology and enriching customer experiences in 80+ countries. Your work will influence our compliance coverage, customer journeys, and operational capacity. You will help shape the future of work by ensuring fast, intuitive, and impactful interactions for organizations employing anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, high quality service and delightful customer experience. The specialist also provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources. As part of the Lifecycle team, you will drive process improvements in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner with generalist HR competencies across the employee lifecycle.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law are a plus.
  • Experience independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; providing comprehensive HR advice on employment laws across jurisdictions.
  • Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline, and workplace investigations.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, and communicate recommendations clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Superior communication, influencing, conflict management and negotiation skills; ability to lead difficult conversations with professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Business-level English (advanced), with additional languages a plus.
  • Aptitude for innovating and optimizing processes, including automation and best practices.
  • Attention to data integrity and thorough record-keeping.
  • Tech-savvy and able to collaborate asynchronously using evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, remote, international team; willing to work flexible hours.
  • Proactive, self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and resolve complex end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions with minimal supervision; prioritize a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
  • Provide guidance on termination, resignation and transfer procedures, contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Independently lead meetings with clients and external employees (e.g., workforce reductions, administrative hearings, negotiations, settlements) and deliver termination outcomes.
  • Navigate complex terminations to achieve positive outcomes, coordinating with multiple stakeholders with competing interests.
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits (payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, unions).
  • Draft and tailor termination documents with accuracy, maintaining privacy and confidentiality.
  • Process offboarding in Remote's HRIS, collaborating with Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, and others to ensure correct administration.
  • Provide mentorship to junior team members and act as a first point of informal escalation on employee relations matters.
  • Guide clients in navigating Remote's Employee Relations resources and complex workplace scenarios.
  • Assess workplace concerns, identify key facts and applicable laws, and determine potential paths forward.
  • Serve as a trusted resource on employee relations, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
  • Advocate for process improvements, automation, product development, and improved customer and employee experience in offboarding and employee relations.
  • Determine methods and standards on new assignments, applying judgment to achieve results aligned with Lifecycle and Remote needs.

Practical details

  • You'll report to: Manager, Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: LATAM
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Remote Compensation Philosophy

Remote’s total rewards philosophy aims to ensure fair compensation and competitive benefits in all locations. We pay above in-location rates and hire globally. Our salary bands are geo-based to reflect geographic pay differentials and market demands.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $41,900 to $94,300 USD. Actual pay depends on location, skills, experience, and business needs. The range may change over time. See the handbook for full benefits information.

  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with; low-ego collaborator with clear communication.

The Opportunity

What to Include

title: Project Manager II, Trucks
description:
About Us

CALSTART is a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, CALSTART’s mission is to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

About the Role

The purpose of the Project Manager 2, Trucks role is to ensure the effective implementation and management of Incentive Projects and other CALSTART initiatives. This involves educating and training stakeholders, improving technical systems, streamlining administrative processes, and ensuring data management and reporting. By coordinating with internal teams and engaging external stakeholders, the role will support project successes and foster strong relationships within the industry and with regulatory bodies.

The Project Manager 2, Trucks role will support external stakeholders by educating and training dealers and equipment purchasers, addressing their inquiries, and assisting with Salesforce technical issues to ensure smooth participation in the incentive projects. For internal stakeholders, the role will streamline project administration, update incentive websites and equipment catalogs, and handle data acquisition and reporting. They will lead the development of standard operating procedures, help organize events and webinars, draft communications, and ensure coordinated efforts and effective project execution. This role also involves collaborating with internal teams and engaging with industry participants and funders to maintain stakeholder relationships and support the overall success of CALSTART initiatives.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead dealer education initiative and involvement, training dealers and purchasers on participating in the incentive projects (e.g. responding to inquiry emails, assisting with or escalating Salesforce technical issues, preparing presentations to inform how the voucher processes work, etc.)
  • Assist with all tasks related to administering incentive projects by fulfilling functions as outlined in grant agreements, including but not limited to developing Implementation Manuals, policies, and procedures, streamlining voucher approval and processing workflows in Salesforce, and engaging industry stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with participating OEMs and dealers to drive outreach initiatives, manage and oversee equipment eligibility verification and catalog management while developing and implementing standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline processes and ensure accuracy and consistency across projects
  • Input new OEMs, Dealers, and Equipment to the Voucher Processing Center catalog, provide feedback to the Salesforce development team on system processes for improvements or maintenance, and lead efforts to improve the dealer user experience of Voucher Processing Center, and assist the Voucher Processing team with system issues or processing inquiries.
  • Help with monthly data acquisition, validation, and reporting (e.g. manage vendor data collection process, work with internal data and validation team to create monthly reports) and keep records for engagements and meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Use CALSTART CRM (Customer Relationship Management) systems such as Salesforce and Monday.com to keep and maintain records and perform and track daily tasks.
  • Lead the development of standard operating procedures for internal processes and using project management tools to further develop enhancements of the program as it pertains to reporting, program funding launches, and program development.
  • Support organizing and attending project-related workshops, events, forums, presentations, and webinars, such as drafting announcement emails and presentation slides, coordinating with communications managing webinars, and strategize communication tactics for workgroups and webinars
  • Assist with other tasks or other CALSTART initiatives as requested by other teams/departments

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, with strong skills in timeline development, resource allocation, budget management, risk assessment, and cross-functional team coordination.
  • 1-2 years of experience with Salesforce, including skills in custom object creation, workflow automation, report generation, data management, and user administration.
  • Project management experience demonstrating proficiency in scope definition, team leadership, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience with Salesforce, including skills in data integration, process automation, dashboard creation, and system customization.
  • Experience supporting diverse stakeholders, with skills in effective communication, conflict resolution, needs assessment, and tailored solution delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and streamline administrative workflows, with skills in process optimization, documentation management, and workflow automation.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders, utilizing collaboration tools, stakeholder management techniques, cross-functional coordination, and conflict resolution strategies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Public Policy, Business Administration, or related fields, with skills in data analysis, project management, policy development, and stakeholder communication.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in sales, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual support.
  • Experience in the Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) industry or related initiatives, showcasing a strong understanding of industry-specific trends and regulations.

Salary: $72,000 - $85,760 a year

CALSTART values transparency and strives to provide as much information regarding compensation as possible. The complete salary range for this role is $72,000-$85,760. Pay is determined based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, experience, education, internal equity and other factors relevant to the job.

We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn’t perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success!

We care about your personal well being as much as your professional success and offer generous benefits to full time employees including: 100% company paid comprehensive health benefits for Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability and Life Insurance, Retirement plan with generous company contributions, FSA for Health and Dependent Care, 3 weeks of vacation time in the first year of employment, 11 paid company holidays, paid sick time, paid family leave, and more!

Our inclusive environment focuses on making decisions based on merit without regard to race, color, hair texture, gender, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, LGBTQIA+ status, marital status, pregnancy, disability, genetics, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Tech Lead Manager
description:
About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, including Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and SoftBank, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year. Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit:

Location & Remote Work
Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Tech Lead Manager responsibilities at QuintoAndar

At QuintoAndar, the Technical Lead Manager (TLM) role begins at the Senior Software Engineer level and bridges both technical leadership and people management. TLMs are responsible for setting the technical direction, ensuring high-quality execution, and managing their team's career development and priorities. This role requires a strong technical foundation combined with a passion for managing people. While TLMs have a more focused management scope compared to traditional managers at the same level, they remain a core part of the technical track. This means career growth can occur within the technical path, progressing toward Staff+ roles, or laterally into the management track with increased management responsibilities and direct reports.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the technical implementation of projects, solving complex problems, ensuring progress, and delivering high-quality, scalable, maintainable, and efficient solutions. This includes addressing core engineering needs.
  • Grow, coach, and manage a diverse and inclusive team of 2–5 skilled software engineers, supporting their career development and helping them achieve their goals.
  • Define and maintain the engineering culture while guiding the design of technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-organizational teams to drive technical alignment, balance trade-offs, and ensure timely project delivery alongside your senior manager.

Hiring Process Stages

The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

  • Application
  • People Interview
  • Tech Screening - architecture
  • Technical interview - coding, architecture and leadership interview
  • Offer

About the Team

Every Engineer responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

  • Develop independent services and platforms to enable our Product to evolve (e.g. parts of billing, visit scheduling, price optimization, self-service negotiation);
  • Create easy-to-understand, well-documented APIs.
  • Create scalable, maintainable and user driven solutions. We use several different technologies. You don\'t need to know all these upfront, but you need to learn fast.
  • Deal effectively with legacy code when necessary.

Tech Lead Manager responsibilities at QuintoAndar: On top of being a great Developer we expect you to:

  • Be a reference for your team. Be a great leader and a great manager.
  • Be strong technically and able to jump in and code parts of the problems we\'re solving.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design and Data to define a winning strategy and execution for your organization.
  • Help the career development of your reports
  • Build a great team both recruiting great talent and helping them grow

Requirements

What we are looking for:

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, with a willingness to learn others.
  • Have already led other Software Engineers into a successful product or platform.
  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through high-quality data-driven and structured software, valuing work-life balance;
  • A strong sense of ownership, capable of managing end-to-end problem-solving, while also delegating effectively and seeking out the knowledge needed to get the job done.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and working proficiency in English, as we use English for code, documentation, tools, and communication with international partners and teams

You\'ll stand out if you :

  • Are equally excited about hands-on technical work and leading teams to achieve peak performance.
  • Have experience managing complex projects with multiple dependencies.
  • Have already built winning Products or Platforms on successful companies.
  • Have worked with large-scale, distributed systems and understand how to test and optimize scalability.
  • Bring excellent people management skills with a proven track record of developing high-performing teams.
  • Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and leada diverse team.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Profit sharing
  • Meal allowance
  • Health insurance
  • Dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Childcare subsidy and Atypical Parenthood subsidy
  • Wellhub
  • Home office allowance
  • Employee assistance program (mental health, social, legal, and financial support)
  • Extended parental leave
  • Day off on birthday, Mother\'s Day, and Father\'s Day
  • Benefits Club (discounts on everyday services)
  • Discounts at educational institutions
  • Reading kit for children – PlayKids

Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

You\'ll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.

Privacy and Data Protection

The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates. For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel.
